audit.whatIsWrong: Content told the reader Winds of War outranges Locke's walk-up. Ritual Nails is 950 range; Winds of War is 825 — Locke owns the poke range, and the lane is lost to Justice Punch step-ups and the taunt, not to a range deficit.
audit.why: Kit ranges: Locke Q 950, Galio Q 825, Galio E 650, Galio W 275.
audit.corrected: Lane stays Galio-favoured (46.37% over 1641 games) because of Justice Punch and the taunt, not poke range. Rewritten in whys[1] and spikes[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with itself and with the packet: win[4]/win[5] and phases[4].side/phases[5].side said Galio while whys[4]/whys[5] both said the stage is even, and the packet chart lists Skill at those rows.
audit.why: packet.levelChart = [Galio, Galio, Galio, Galio, Skill, Skill, Galio].
audit.corrected: Rows 5 and 6 (Level 6, First item) set to Skill in both layers with matching 5/10 ratings — Purgatory's 120s at rank 1 plus a Lich Bane spike is the even window before his MR scaling retakes the lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Ignition was described as burst that 'bounces off' his shield, and no text stated what the ability actually does: it costs Locke health up front and refunds only a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.
audit.why: Riot text: 'dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.' That makes W a committed-trade button, never a poke button.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[0] — pay Soul Ignition's self-damage only inside a committed trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield of Durand's taunt (275 range, 18/17/16/15/14s) was never named as the punish for Locke's E, and Justice Punch's real 11/10/9/8/7s cooldown never appeared as a number.
audit.why: E is Locke's only dash and his exit; a taunt inside 275 range removes it.
audit.corrected: Stated in report[5] and dosFull[0].d with the cooldown numbers.

audit.why: No patch-driven change verified for 26.15; nothing asserted.

edits.before: Level 2 stays Galio as Q Winds of War poke outranges your walk-up.
edits.after: Level 2 stays Galio — Justice Punch (11s) punishes your walk-up.

edits.before: Galio owns this range — his W Shield of Durand magic resist plus passive Colossal Smash on-hit makes him nearly immune to your Q Ritual Nails and W Soul Ignition magic burst while he pokes with Q Winds of War.
edits.after: Galio owns this range — Shield of Durand's reduction blunts Ritual Nails, and Soul Ignition only refunds part of the damage you take, so pay its self-damage inside a committed trade, never to poke a full-HP Galio.

edits.before: Late game returns to Galio — his W magic-resist wall and global R Hero's Entrance make him tanky and slippery, and his built-in MR outscales your single-target magic burst.
edits.after: Late game returns to Galio — Shield of Durand plus his MR wall blunts your burst, and Hero's Entrance (140s at rank 3, 5500 range) lets him leave the map the moment you commit.

edits.before: Track Galio’s Justice Punch: His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Track Justice Punch (11s): his engage and knockup. Shield of Durand taunts on release — don't spend E inside its 275 range.

edits.before: His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Only commit once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Justice Punch (11s at rank 1) is his only engage — chip him while it is down and deny the reset.

notes: Level chart rows 5-6 were internally contradictory (win/phases said Galio, whys said even); fixed as a paired atomic group with matching ratings. The load-bearing error carried over from the mirror: Ritual Nails 950 outranges Winds of War 825, so the old 'he pokes you out' framing was backwards. Soul Ignition's refund-on-damage-taken clause appeared nowhere in either layer.
